title: Lear takes UFO claims to KLAS; Knapp checks the files

tellings.quote: Um and then he walks in with this UFO madness.

plain: In the late 1980s John Lear, a pilot with a famous name in aviation, walked into KLAS, a Las Vegas TV station, with what was called "this UFO madness," and the reporter George Knapp went to check the files, with the newsman Ned Day also part of the story. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells Michels this second-hand, from people involved; it is the start of how Las Vegas TV came to take up UFO stories.
